tool_input.command: for f in src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/styles/base.css tests/smoke.spec.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat -n "$f"; done
tool_input.description: Print all source, style, and test files
Fix band full-bleed margin to include page padding

tool_input.command: $p = 'src/components/Sticker.tsx'; $c = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p); $c = $c.Replace('<path d={GLYPHS_LG[glyph]} fill', '<path className="sticker-glyph" d={GLYPHS_LG[glyph]} fill').Replace('<path d={GLYPHS_SM[glyph]} fill', '<path className="sticker-glyph" d={GLYPHS_SM[glyph]} fill'); [IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $c); (Select-String -Path $p -Pattern 'sticker-glyph').Count
tool_input.description: Add glyph class to sticker paths
